item.title: PM Modi pays tribute to Mahatma Gandhi on death anniversary, highlights swadeshi & non-violence
item.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Friday paid homage to Mahatma Gandhi on his 78th death anniversary, recalling the Father of the Nation’s emphasis on Swadeshi as a cornerstone of a self-reliant India. item.title: Body of man found at Odisha minister’s official residence in Bhubaneswar, probe underway
item.description: The body of a man was recovered from the official residence of Odisha Food Supplies and Consumer Welfare Minister Krushna Chandra Patra in Bhubaneswar on Thursday, triggering concern and prompting a police investigation. The deceased has been identified as Shankarshan Nag, aged 46. According to initial reports, he was a native of Belpahad village in Bolangir district and was serving as an aide to the minister. item.title: Paddy smuggling attempt thwarted in Balasore, 1,800 bags seized near Odisha border
item.description: The Balasore district administration has foiled an alleged attempt to illegally transport paddy into Odisha from West Bengal, seizing a large consignment near the state border. Officials said 1,800 bags of paddy were confiscated during a raid conducted by the Supply Department near the Laxmannath toll gate on Thursday. item.description: Challenging the notion that weight loss requires strict diets and intense workout routines, social media influencer Shivani Karnick has shared her journey of losing 10 kg through a flexible and balanced lifestyle approach. Her experience highlights how consistency, patience and enjoyment can lead to sustainable results. item.title: Container truck crashes into bitumen tanker at Tamando chhak, traffic disrupted in Bhubaneswar
item.description: A major road accident involving a container truck and a bitumen-laden tanker caused severe traffic disruption at Tamando Chowk in Bhubaneswar on Friday morning. The collision led to a large-scale spillage of bitumen on the road, blocking one side of the carriageway and triggering long traffic snarls. item.title: Mutilated body of youth discovered on Khordha–Bolangir highway, police investigate
item.description: In a tragic incident early on Friday morning, a youth was found dead in a mutilated condition on the Khordha–Bolangir National Highway near Sorada Chhak under Nuagaon police station in Nayagarh. Locals said dense fog in the area may have contributed to the accident, resulting in low visibility. The victim’s dismembered body was reportedly struck by an unknown vehicle, which fled the spot immediately after the incident. The identity of the deceased has not yet been confirmed. item.title: Odisha records strong economic growth, NSDP rises to Rs 7.90 lakh crore
item.description: Odisha’s Net State Domestic Product (NSDP) has risen from Rs 6.99 lakh crore in 2023–24 to an estimated Rs 7.90 lakh crore in 2024–25, with growth accelerating to 13.04 per cent. Chief Minister Mohan Charan Majhi shared the figures, citing the Economic Survey of India (2025–26), tabled in Parliament by Union Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman. item.title: Pan masala will not be banned in Odisha, Health Department clarifies
item.description: The Odisha government has clarified that pan masala will not be banned in the state, putting an end to speculation following a recent notification on tobacco-related products. The clarification has been issued by the Health and Family Welfare Department through an official letter addressed to the Commissioners of CT & GST and the Finance Department. item.title: 28 OISF personnel injured in bus–truck collision in Odisha’s Keonjhar
item.description: At least 28 personnel of the Odisha Industrial Security Force (OISF) were injured after a bus carrying them met with an accident in Keonjhar district early on Friday. The mishap occurred near Taduabahal on National Highway 520 under the jurisdiction of Champua police station. According to preliminary information, the bus was travelling from Jalaput to Keonjhar when a speeding truck rammed into it from behind. item.title: Car rams into electric pole in Sambalpur, engine thrown 100 feet away
item.description: A high-speed car accident at Ainthapali in Odisha’s Sambalpur district late on Thursday night caused extensive damage to a four-wheeler, with the impact of the crash flinging the vehicle’s engine nearly 100 feet away. Despite the severity of the collision, the driver narrowly escaped without sustaining any life-threatening injuries. No casualties were reported in the incident.
